# Seasonality: Forex Indices [invincible3]

- url: https://www.tradingview.com/script/srqbmZGs-Seasonality-Forex-Indices-invincible3/

- pine_id: PUB;f9944f2a4e604278a8814edd40a52f0e
- version: 1.0

## Description

[b]Seasonality: Forex Index [invincible3] [/b]

Seasonality: Forex Index is a visual seasonality dashboard designed to help traders analyze historical yearly patterns across major currency indexes.

The indicator displays compact 365-day seasonal mini charts directly on the price chart. Each currency index is shown in its own separate panel, allowing traders to quickly compare seasonal strength, weakness, turning points, and recurring calendar-based tendencies throughout the year.

Included forex indexes:

• Australian Dollar
• Canadian Dollar
• Swiss Franc
• Dollar Index
• Euro
• British Pound
• Japanese Yen

[b]Each currency includes two seasonal curves:[/b]

Blue Line — All Years Average
Shows the long-term historical seasonal tendency for the selected currency index.

Yellow Line — Weighted Average
Shows a weighted seasonal curve designed to give more importance to recent seasonal behavior while still preserving the broader historical pattern.

The dashboard is fully customizable. Users can enable or disable individual currency indexes, choose whether to display the All Years curve, the Weighted Average curve, or both, and adjust the widget width, distance from candles, column spacing, panel height, row gap, and dashboard placement.

[b]Key Features:[/b]

• Seasonality dashboard for major forex indexes
• Includes AUD, CAD, CHF, DXY, EUR, GBP and JPY
• 365-day calendar-based seasonal curves
• All Years average and Weighted Average comparison
• Separate mini chart for each currency index
• Monthly grid lines and month labels
• Adjustable dashboard size, spacing, and placement
• Right-side dashboard placement option
• Auto-theme color support
• Manual customization for line colors, grid, background, and text
• Clean visual panels for quick seasonal comparison

This indicator is useful for identifying periods where major currencies have historically shown stronger or weaker seasonal tendencies. It can help traders add seasonal context to forex pairs, dollar strength analysis, macro bias, trend structure, and technical setups.

The seasonality curves are intended as a relative historical guide, not exact price forecasts. This indicator does not generate direct buy or sell signals. Seasonality should be used as a supporting research tool together with price action, trend analysis, macro fundamentals, confirmation, and proper risk management.

//@version=6
indicator(
     "Seasonality: Forex Indices [invincible3]",
     overlay = true,
     max_lines_count = 500,
     max_labels_count = 500,
     max_boxes_count = 80,
     max_polylines_count = 40
)

//━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
// Settings
//━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
groupLayout = "Mini Chart Layout"

widthBars          = input.int(70, "Widget Width Bars", minval = 35, maxval = 140, group = groupLayout)
offsetBars         = input.int(10, "Distance From Candles Bars", minval = 0, maxval = 180, group = groupLayout)
columnGapBars      = input.int(4, "Gap Between Columns Bars", minval = 0, maxval = 30, group = groupLayout)
placeRightSide     = input.bool(true, "Place Dashboard Right Of Price", group = groupLayout)
lookbackBars       = input.int(700, "Price Range Lookback", minval = 100, maxval = 3000, group = groupLayout)
panelHeightPercent = input.float(0.11, "Each Panel Height % Of Price Range", minval = 0.05, maxval = 0.25, step = 0.01, group = groupLayout)
panelGapPercent    = input.float(0.025, "Gap Between Rows", minval = 0.00, maxval = 0.20, step = 0.005, group = groupLayout)
bottomOffset       = input.float(0.04, "Bottom Offset", minval = 0.00, maxval = 0.50, step = 0.01, group = groupLayout)

groupData = "Seasonality Curves"
showAustralianDollar = input.bool(true, "Show Australian Dollar", group = groupData)
showCanadianDollar = input.bool(true, "Show Canadian Dollar", group = groupData)
showSwissFranc = input.bool(true, "Show Swiss Franc", group = groupData)
showDollarIndex = input.bool(true, "Show Dollar Index", group = groupData)
showEuro = input.bool(true, "Show Euro", group = groupData)
showBritishPound = input.bool(true, "Show British Pound", group = groupData)
showJapaneseYen = input.bool(true, "Show Japanese Yen", group = groupData)
showNewZealandDollar = input.bool(true, "Show New Zealand Dollar", group = groupData)
showAllYears    = input.bool(true, "Show All Years / Blue", group = groupData)
showWeighted    = input.bool(true, "Show Weighted Average / Yellow", group = groupData)

groupStyle = "Style"
autoTheme     = input.bool(true, "Auto Theme Colors", group = groupStyle)
gridColor     = input.color(color.new(color.gray, 45), "Manual Grid Color", group = groupStyle)
allYearsColor = input.color(color.rgb(70, 160, 255), "All Years Line Color", group = groupStyle)
weightedColor = input.color(color.rgb(255, 205, 40), "Weighted Average Line Color", group = groupStyle)
boxBg         = input.color(color.new(color.black, 82), "Manual Box Background", group = groupStyle)
textColor     = input.color(color.silver, "Manual Text Color", group = groupStyle)
lineWidth     = input.int(2, "Seasonal Line Width", minval = 1, maxval = 5, group = groupStyle)

//━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
// Drawing objects
//━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
var box australianDollarBox = na
var box canadianDollarBox = na
var box swissFrancBox = na
var box dollarIndexBox = na
var box euroBox = na
var box britishPoundBox = na
var box japaneseYenBox = na
var box newZealandDollarBox = na

var polyline australianDollarAllYearsLine = na
var polyline australianDollarWeightedLine = na
var polyline canadianDollarAllYearsLine = na
var polyline canadianDollarWeightedLine = na
var polyline swissFrancAllYearsLine = na
var polyline swissFrancWeightedLine = na
var polyline dollarIndexAllYearsLine = na
var polyline dollarIndexWeightedLine = na
var polyline euroAllYearsLine = na
var polyline euroWeightedLine = na
var polyline britishPoundAllYearsLine = na
var polyline britishPoundWeightedLine = na
var polyline japaneseYenAllYearsLine = na
var polyline japaneseYenWeightedLine = na
var polyline newZealandDollarAllYearsLine = na
var polyline newZealandDollarWeightedLine = na

var line[] gridLines = array.new_line()
var label[] chartLabels = array.new_label()

f_luma(color c) =>
    0.299 * color.r(c) + 0.587 * color.g(c) + 0.114 * color.b(c)

f_clear_lines(line[] arr) =>
    if array.size(arr) > 0
        for j = 0 to array.size(arr) - 1
            line.delete(array.get(arr, j))
    array.clear(arr)

f_clear_labels(label[] arr) =>
    if array.size(arr) > 0
        for j = 0 to array.size(arr) - 1
            label.delete(array.get(arr, j))
    array.clear(arr)

f_parse_csv_to_array(string csv, float[] dest) =>
    array.clear(dest)
    string[] tokens = str.split(csv, ",")
    if array.size(tokens) > 0
        for k = 0 to array.size(tokens) - 1
            float v = str.tonumber(array.get(tokens, k))
            if not na(v)
                array.push(dest, v)

f_draw_curve(float[] src, int leftBar, int chartWidth, float minVal, float rangeData, float chartBottom, float chartRange, color lineColor, int lw) =>
    chart.point[] points = array.new<chart.point>()
    int n = array.size(src)
    if n > 1
        for i = 0 to n - 1
            float normalizedVal = (array.get(src, i) - minVal) / rangeData
            float yPos = chartBottom + normalizedVal * chartRange
            int xPos = leftBar + int(math.round(chartWidth * i / float(n - 1)))
            array.push(points, chart.point.from_index(xPos, yPos))
    polyline.new(points = points, curved = false, closed = false, xloc = xloc.bar_index, line_color = lineColor, line_width = lw)

f_draw_panel(
     float[] allData,
     float[] weightedData,
     bool showPanel,
     bool showAll,
     bool showWgt,
     int leftBar,
     int chartWidth,
     float chartBottom,
     float chartTop,
     string titleText,
     color themeTextColor,
     color themeGridColor,
     color themeBorderColor,
     color themeBoxBg
 ) =>
    box panelBox = na
    polyline allLine = na
    polyline weightedLine = na

    bool hasAll = showPanel and showAll and array.size(allData) == 365
    bool hasWgt = showPanel and showWgt and array.size(weightedData) == 365
    bool canDrawPanel = hasAll or hasWgt

    if canDrawPanel
        float maxVal = na
        float minVal = na

        if hasAll
            maxVal := array.max(allData)
            minVal := array.min(allData)

        if hasWgt
            float wMax = array.max(weightedData)
            float wMin = array.min(weightedData)
            maxVal := na(maxVal) ? wMax : math.max(maxVal, wMax)
            minVal := na(minVal) ? wMin : math.min(minVal, wMin)

        float rangeData = math.max(maxVal - minVal, 0.000001)
        float chartRange = chartTop - chartBottom

        panelBox := box.new(left = leftBar, top = chartTop, right = leftBar + chartWidth, bottom = chartBottom, xloc = xloc.bar_index, border_color = themeBorderColor, bgcolor = themeBoxBg)

        int[] monthStarts = array.from(0, 31, 59, 90, 120, 151, 181, 212, 243, 273, 304, 334, 364)
        for i = 0 to 12
            int dayIndex = array.get(monthStarts, i)
            int x = leftBar + int(math.round(chartWidth * dayIndex / 364.0))
            line monthLine = line.new(x1 = x, y1 = chartBottom, x2 = x, y2 = chartTop, xloc = xloc.bar_index, color = themeGridColor, style = line.style_solid, width = 1)
            array.push(gridLines, monthLine)

        for i = 0 to 4
            float y = chartBottom + chartRange * i / 4.0
            line hLine = line.new(x1 = leftBar, y1 = y, x2 = leftBar + chartWidth, y2 = y, xloc = xloc.bar_index, color = themeGridColor, style = line.style_solid, width = 1)
            array.push(gridLines, hLine)

        if hasAll
            allLine := f_draw_curve(allData, leftBar, chartWidth, minVal, rangeData, chartBottom, chartRange, allYearsColor, lineWidth)
        if hasWgt
            weightedLine := f_draw_curve(weightedData, leftBar, chartWidth, minVal, rangeData, chartBottom, chartRange, weightedColor, lineWidth)

        string[] months = array.from("Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "Jun", "Jul", "Aug", "Sep", "Oct", "Nov", "Dec")
        int monthLabelStep = chartWidth <= 80 ? 2 : 1
        for i = 0 to 11
            if i % monthLabelStep == 0
                int startDay = array.get(monthStarts, i)
                int endDay = array.get(monthStarts, i + 1)
                int midDay = int(math.round((startDay + endDay) / 2.0))
                int x = leftBar + int(math.round(chartWidth * midDay / 364.0))
                label monthLabel = label.new(x = x, y = chartBottom - chartRange * 0.08, text = array.get(months, i), xloc = xloc.bar_index, style = label.style_none, textcolor = themeTextColor, size = size.small, textalign = text.align_center)
                array.push(chartLabels, monthLabel)

        label titleLabel = label.new(x = leftBar + int(chartWidth / 2), y = chartTop + chartRange * 0.04, text = titleText, xloc = xloc.bar_index, style = label.style_none, textcolor = themeTextColor, size = size.small, textalign = text.align_center)
        array.push(chartLabels, titleLabel)

        int legendX = leftBar + int(math.round(chartWidth * 0.08))
        if hasAll
            label blueLabel = label.new(x = legendX, y = chartTop - chartRange * 0.13, text = chartWidth <= 80 ? "■ All" : "■ All Years", xloc = xloc.bar_index, style = label.style_none, textcolor = allYearsColor, size = size.small, textalign = text.align_left)
            array.push(chartLabels, blueLabel)
        if hasWgt
            label yellowLabel = label.new(x = legendX, y = chartTop - chartRange * 0.22, text = chartWidth <= 80 ? "■ W.Avg" : "■ Weighted Avg", xloc = xloc.bar_index, style = label.style_none, textcolor = weightedColor, size = size.small, textalign = text.align_left)
            array.push(chartLabels, yellowLabel)

    [panelBox, allLine, weightedLine]
